biggest_catch: The $250 is paid at month end after the account has been open 90 days — expect roughly 3.5 to 4 months from opening to payout.
catches: Offer begins 9/1/26; open a new Sage Federal Credit Union Simple Checking, Rewards Checking, Compass Checking, or Pathfinder Checking account by 11/30/2026.
Receive a direct deposit of at least $500 within the first 90 days of account opening.
Limited to those who were not primary owners of a Sage CU Simple Checking, Rewards Checking, Compass Checking, or Pathfinder Checking account on 08/31/26.
Bonus deposited to the new checking account at the month end after the account has been open 90 days, provided all requirements are met and the account is open and in good standing at that time.
Limit one New Checking Account Bonus per member.
Sage CU reserves the right to cancel or amend the terms at any time without prior notice.
Membership requires maintaining at least $5.00 in a Membership Savings account.
Bonuses are considered dividends and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT; recipients are responsible for any taxes.
Must be eligible for Sage CU membership (field-of-membership: OR counties Klamath, Lake, Harney, Malheur; CA counties Modoc, Siskiyou; NV counties Humboldt, Pershing, Lander, Eureka).

Open a new Simple, Rewards, Compass, or Pathfinder Checking account by November 30, 2026.
